customManagers.description: Track the setup-go `go-version` literal in workflow run steps. Renovate's github-actions manager does not parse this input, so without a custom manager CI keeps validating on an old Go while go.mod and the golang Docker image advance. Mapped to the `go` dependency so it moves with the go-toolchain group.

Track govulncheck pinned via `go install golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@vX` in workflow run steps, which no built-in manager parses. Needed so the go-toolchain group keeps govulncheck in lockstep with the Go release — its SSA builder panics on syntax from a newer stdlib.

Track deadcode pinned via `go install golang.org/x/tools/cmd/deadcode@vX` in workflow run steps, which no built-in manager parses. Needed so the go-toolchain group keeps deadcode in lockstep with the Go release — its SSA builder panics on syntax from a newer stdlib.

packageRules.description: Keep the Go toolchain and everything version-locked to it in one PR: the language version (go.mod directive + setup-go), the golang Docker image, golangci-lint, and the x/tools (deadcode) and x/vuln (govulncheck) analyzers. A Go bump that outpaces the tooling breaks CI — the analyzers' SSA builders panic on new syntax and golangci-lint hits typecheck errors on the new stdlib. Grouping forces CI to validate the whole set together instead of merging them piecemeal.
